subtypes.grating: grating coupler (1D, apodized, 2D/PSGC, dual-layer, bottom reflector, focusing, photonic-crystal)
subtypes.edge: edge coupler / spot-size converter (inverse taper, trident, cantilever, SiN/SiON/polymer SSC)
subtypes.photonic_wire_bond: freeform polymer wire bond from a fiber / fiber array to an on-chip coupler

subtypes.vertical_taper: vertical tapered waveguide / reflector to PD or fiber

subtypes.tff: thin-film filter in an optical sub-assembly

subtypes.iii_v_on_platform: III-V PD integrated on Si / SiN / TFLN

subtypes.heterogeneous: heterogeneous / transfer-printed laser on a PIC
subtypes.tunable: widely tunable laser (Vernier rings, sampled grating)

subtypes.transition: on-chip inter-layer / inter-material transition (monolithic or bonded on the same chip; between separate dies -> chip_chip_coupler)

insertion_loss_db.def: power loss of the component at the stated scope, positive dB (coupling loss for couplers, IL for filters, isolators, polarization devices, phase shifters)

coupling_efficiency_pct.def: coupled power fraction at the stated scope (linear, as reported)

excess_loss_db.def: loss beyond the ideal split / transmission, positive dB

bw_1db_nm.def: full width where transmission stays within 1 dB of its peak

bw_3db_nm.def: full width at -3 dB (or FWHM of a power spectrum when the paper calls it 3 dB)

bw_fwhm_nm.def: full width at half maximum as the source states it (not equated with a 3-dB width unless the source does)

center_wavelength_nm.def: peak / center wavelength of the response

wdl_db.def: wavelength-dependent loss over the stated range

back_reflection_db.def: back-reflection magnitude, positive dB below the input

power_handling_dbm.def: highest input power without degradation as stated (stable up to X -> X with gt)

fiber_angle_deg.def: fiber tilt from the chip normal (sign as printed)

period_nm.def: grating period (a discrete set of periods: one row per period, or a range with the set in condition)

fill_factor.def: grating fill factor = tooth (unetched) width / period; a paper that defines the etched-gap fraction is converted (1 - value, basis derived, printed value and definition in notes)

mfd_chip_um.def: mode-field diameter at the chip facet (1/e^2 unless the note says otherwise)

mfd_fiber_um.def: mode-field diameter of the fiber / beam the component couples to

tol_1db_lateral_um.def: lateral misalignment for 1 dB excess loss (half-width, +/- value)

tol_1db_longitudinal_um.def: longitudinal (z) misalignment for 1 dB excess loss

beam_diameter_um.def: beam diameter at the interface (expanded / collimated beam)

lens_radius_um.def: lens radius of curvature or aperture radius as stated

split_ratio_pct.def: power fraction to the stated port (cross / bar as noted)

coupling_variation.def: variation of the power coupling coefficient over the stated wavelength span

gap_nm.def: coupling gap (vertical gap for inter-layer transitions and multilevel crossings; switch_fabric: gap of its directional couplers)

crossing_loss_db.def: insertion loss per crossing, positive dB

crosstalk_db.def: crosstalk suppression magnitude, positive dB; for wdm only when the type (adjacent / non-adjacent / cumulative) is not stated, with the stated wording in condition

q_loaded.def: loaded quality factor (an unqualified Q goes here with a note)

q_intrinsic.def: intrinsic quality factor; extraction model / reference resonator in notes

fsr_nm.def: free spectral range in wavelength (laser: longitudinal-mode spacing of the laser cavity or the FSR of an intracavity filter, which one in condition; comb / coupled resonators: which resonator in condition)

fsr_ghz.def: free spectral range in frequency (laser: longitudinal-mode spacing of the laser cavity or the FSR of an intracavity filter, which one in condition; comb / coupled resonators: which resonator in condition; frequency converter: which mode family, e.g. fundamental-harmonic modes, in condition)

radius_um.def: ring / disk radius (racetrack: bend radius; length in notes)

extinction_db.def: notch depth, stopband contrast or on/off extinction magnitude, positive dB; for a splitter or phase shifter the extinction of an interferometer / amplitude contrast as stated, for a mode converter the mode-rejection / extinction ratio (type in condition)

linewidth_pm.def: resonance full width as reported (not converted to a 3-dB width or Q)

n_periods.def: number of grating periods / photonic-crystal cells

stopband_width_nm.def: stopband full width at the stated contrast level (level in condition)

slsr_db.def: sidelobe suppression ratio, positive dB (free-space emitter: far-field main lobe over the highest sidelobe / grating lobe, as stated)

linewidth_mhz.def: loaded resonance full width in frequency as reported (an intrinsic loss rate goes in kappa_intrinsic_mhz)

kappa_intrinsic_mhz.def: intrinsic energy decay rate kappa_0 / 2 pi

group_index.def: optical group index as reported (method in notes)

power_coupling_pct.def: bus-to-resonator power coupling coefficient as reported

drop_loss_db.def: drop-port insertion loss at resonance, positive dB

il_nonuniformity_db.def: max minus min channel / port insertion loss

crosstalk_adjacent_db.def: adjacent-channel crosstalk suppression magnitude, positive dB (at center unless noted)

crosstalk_nonadjacent_db.def: non-adjacent-channel crosstalk suppression magnitude, positive dB

crosstalk_cumulative_db.def: cumulative (integrated) crosstalk suppression magnitude, positive dB

tuning_power_mw.def: heater / tuning power for the stated range (per channel or per FSR in notes)

p_pi_mw.def: electrical power for a pi phase shift

v_pi_v.def: voltage for a pi phase shift (2pi values in notes)

bw3db_khz.def: small-signal 3-dB modulation bandwidth of a thermo-optic / MEMS / PCM actuator

tuning_efficiency_pm_per_mw.def: resonance / wavelength shift per mW of heater power, or of device electrical input for self-heating (actuator in condition)

thermal_time_constant_us.def: first-order thermal time constant as stated (not a 10-90 % rise time)

tracking_time_us.def: time to reach the stated target in closed-loop tracking

responsivity_a_per_w.def: responsivity; reference plane (internal / fiber-referred) in ref_plane

dark_current_na.def: dark current at the stated bias

saturation_power_dbm.def: saturation input power as defined by the paper

quantum_efficiency_pct.def: external / internal quantum efficiency (type in notes)

output_power_dbm.def: optical output power; reference plane (chip / fiber / module) in ref_plane

output_power_mw.def: optical output power in mW as reported

linewidth_hz.def: linewidth; intrinsic / Lorentzian vs integrated in condition

rin_db_per_hz.def: relative intensity noise (negative dB/Hz as reported)

repetition_rate_ghz.def: pulse repetition rate of a mode-locked laser / comb

tuning_efficiency_pm_per_v.def: resonance / wavelength shift per volt of a non-thermal actuator (piezo, Pockels bias)

rin_integrated_pct.def: RIN integrated over the band given in condition

power_consumption_w.def: electrical power consumption as stated (scope in condition)

power_uniformity_db.def: max minus min output power across channels / ports

wavelength_spread_nm.def: spread of the lasing / resonance / channel wavelength across chips or channels (+/- value as stated, kind in condition)

psat_out_dbm.def: output saturation power (1-dB compression unless noted)

avalanche_gain.def: avalanche (multiplication) gain at the stated bias, reference point in notes

breakdown_voltage_v.def: breakdown voltage (sign as printed; criterion in notes)

saturation_photocurrent_ma.def: highest / saturation photocurrent as defined by the paper (definition in condition)

relaxation_oscillation_ghz.def: relaxation oscillation frequency at the stated current

forward_voltage_v.def: forward voltage at the stated current

pump_to_comb_efficiency_pct.def: pump-to-comb power conversion efficiency as defined by the paper

beam_divergence_deg.def: beam divergence angle (full or half angle and level in condition)

phase_shift_pi.def: phase shift reached / retained, in units of pi (rad values converted, basis derived)

retention_time_s.def: retention time of a non-volatile state as stated

mech_resonance_khz.def: mechanical resonance frequency of a MEMS actuator

dark_count_rate_hz.def: dark count rate of a single-photon detector (counts per second; bias current / excess bias and temperature in condition / temperature_k)

afterpulse_probability_pct.def: afterpulsing probability as defined by the paper (hold-off / dead time and detection efficiency in condition)

timing_jitter_ps.def: detector timing jitter (FWHM or rms in condition); pulse-train jitter of a laser: timing_jitter_fs

max_count_rate_mhz.def: maximum count rate of a single-photon detector as stated (criterion in condition when given)

recovery_time_ns.def: recovery / reset time of a single-photon detector as defined by the paper (e.g. 1/e decay of the output pulse, dead time; definition in condition)

critical_current_ua.def: critical (switching) current of a superconducting nanowire at the stated temperature (definition in condition)

series_resistance_ohm.def: device series resistance (method in notes: I-V slope, equivalent-circuit S11 fit); amplifier added

excess_noise_factor.def: APD excess noise factor F at the stated multiplication gain (gain in condition)

dark_current_density_ma_per_cm2.def: dark current per junction area at the stated bias (A/cm2 values converted, basis derived)

endurance_cycles.def: switching / programming cycles demonstrated as stated (degradation criterion in condition)

n_levels.def: number of distinguishable non-volatile levels (states) demonstrated

gain_db_per_cm.def: gain per unit length as stated (internal / net in condition)

gain_bandwidth_nm.def: wavelength span over which the stated gain criterion holds (criterion, e.g. internal net gain > 0 dB, in condition); a 3-dB gain width is bw_3db_nm

power_conversion_efficiency_pct.def: optical power conversion efficiency as defined by the paper (pump-to-signal, fundamental-to-harmonic, pump-to-signal+idler; definition and reference plane in condition); laser wall-plug: wpe_pct

conversion_efficiency_pct_per_w_cm2.def: length-normalized nonlinear conversion efficiency as reported (%/W/cm2)

thermal_resistance_k_per_w.def: thermal resistance (active-region temperature rise per W of dissipated power; method in notes)

characteristic_temperature_k.def: characteristic temperature T0 of the threshold current (temperature range in condition)

isolation_bw_nm.def: full width over which isolation exceeds the stated level (level in condition)

steering_range_deg.def: beam-steering range (field of view) as stated; axis and full vs +/- span in condition

steering_efficiency_deg_per_nm.def: emission-angle change per nm of wavelength (sign as printed)

mdl_db.def: mode-dependent loss (spread of loss over the guided modes, per core or total as stated in condition)

dgd_ps.def: differential group delay between polarization (or mode) eigenstates over the stated length (length in condition; per-length values: ps/m printed in notes)

coupling_angle_deg.def: angle subtended by the curved coupling section of a bent directional coupler

bw_fwhm_ghz.def: channel passband full width at half maximum in frequency, as the source states it (not equated with a 3-dB width unless the source does)

drop_efficiency_pct.def: drop-port power transmission at resonance (linear, as reported; dB form: drop_loss_db)

xt_bandwidth_nm.def: full width over which crosstalk stays below the stated level (level and port state in condition)

prop_loss_db_per_cm.def: propagation loss (dB/m and dB/mm converted with a derived note)

min_bend_radius_um.def: smallest bend radius used or stated

emission_angle_deg.def: emission angle from the chip normal

cladding_thickness_um.def: upper cladding thickness above the core

layer2_thickness_nm.def: thickness of the second guiding layer of a bilayer / inter-layer structure (material in condition)

lower_tip_width_nm.def: tip width of the lower-layer taper (upper-layer tip: tip_width_nm)

overlay_width_um.def: width of the overlay / cladding waveguide of a spot-size converter

overlay_thickness_um.def: thickness of the overlay / cladding waveguide of a spot-size converter

grating_width_um.def: lateral width of the grating region

bus_width_nm.def: bus waveguide width (ring / racetrack waveguide width: width_nm)

coupling_length_um.def: length of the straight coupling section (racetrack, directional coupler)

port_width_um.def: access-taper width where it meets the multimode section

arm_length_increment_um.def: path-length increment between adjacent arrayed waveguides or MZI arms

ridge_width_um.def: ridge / mesa width of an active waveguide

lower_width_nm.def: lower-layer waveguide width of an inter-layer structure (upper layer: width_nm)

overlay_slab_thickness_um.def: slab thickness of a rib-shaped overlay waveguide (total height: overlay_thickness_um)

subwavelength_period_nm.def: period of a transverse or sub-wavelength (SWG) structure, distinct from the diffraction-grating period_nm

heater_offset_um.def: lateral offset of the heater centre from the waveguide centre (vertical distance: heater_gap_um)

slab_thickness_nm.def: remaining slab thickness of a rib

sidewall_angle_deg.def: sidewall angle to the film plane (90 = vertical)

edge_taper.label: Edge coupler / spot-size converter (inverse taper, optional overlay)

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db among AWGs reporting n_arms and n_channels
showcase.rationale: LIGENTEC AN800 MPW, 800 nm Si3N4: 6 x 6 AWG, 200 GHz (1.6 nm), 25 arrayed waveguides (2 um wide, 3.5 um pitch), FPR 111.75 um, order 112; peak on-chip losses 1.14 to 2.75 dB from centre input 3 to the six outputs, normalized to a reference waveguide; adjacent crosstalk -23.7 to -30.4 dB. Same chip 8 x 8 router (AWG1): 1.26 dB central channel. Th2A.9 (0.98 dB) reports no arm count

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db among AWGs reporting n_arms and n_channels
showcase.rationale: imec passive SOI platform (220 nm Si on 2 um oxide, 193 nm lithography, 1 nm mask grid): 8 x 400 GHz AWG, 40 arrayed waveguides, 490 x 307 um2; insertion loss 1.3 dB (highest-power channel) to 2.7 dB (lowest), crosstalk -26 dB (Table I). Second platform (soi). The paper attributes IL differences between the 1 nm and 5 nm grid copies (5 nm copy: 2.3 to 3.7 dB) to normalization and wafer variation

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW AWG with measured insertion loss
showcase.rationale: CUMEC 16 x 16 Si AWG, 0.98 dB central-channel IL, adjacent crosstalk > 22.7 dB, 2 um arrayed waveguides, 550 x 590 um2; number of arms not reported (template drawn schematically)

showcase.criterion: foundry AWG with measured insertion loss closest to the median of measured AWG insertion loss (2.1 dB, n = 28 wdm.awg components, bound-only values excluded), reporting n_arms and n_channels
showcase.rationale: imec 248 nm DUV SOI: 16-channel 200 GHz AWG with 36 arms, 500 x 200 um; 2.2 dB insertion loss in the centre output ports (central input, normalized to a photonic wire), general crosstalk -17 to -20 dB, 3 dB centre-to-edge nonuniformity. Ties at 0.1 dB from the median with two pathak2014 copies (16 x 200 GHz 1 nm grid, 2.0 dB; 4 x 400 GHz 5 nm grid, 2.2 dB; both best-channel ends of a channel range) broken by the single centre-port value

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW directional coupler with measured performance and a drawable gap and coupling length
showcase.rationale: CSEM TFLN MPW run, gap 660 nm, coupling length 34.5 um, 600 nm wide in the coupling region, 600 nm film / 400 nm etch; measured split 12:88 (bar:cross); excess loss not reported

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW directional coupler with measured performance and a drawable gap and coupling length, second platform
showcase.rationale: imec iSiPP300 (193 nm immersion): straight symmetric 0.5:0.5 DC, gap 100 nm, coupling length 5.228 um, 380 x 220 nm strip waveguides, 5 um circular input / output bends; measured coupling ratios with cross-coupling variation 0.391 over an 80 nm span (reference design for the paper bent DC); excess loss only as model-fit values (0.07 / 0.126 dB, derived). SOI platform

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)
showcase.rationale: 0.52 dB per coupler TE (0.60 dB TM) at 1550 nm with a tapered lensed fiber (2.5 um spot), best polarization-independent tip of a measured tip-width sweep (Table III); 350 nm tip, 100 um linear inverse taper, 0.75 um access waveguide, 400 nm LPCVD SiN on 4.5 um thermal SiO2, 3 um PECVD SiO2 cladding; Applied Nanotools SiN rapid-prototyping process

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)
showcase.rationale: 0.56-2.21 dB per facet over 1310-2000 nm (0.56 dB at 1590 nm), SiON overlay SSC with full design table: 0.2 um LN tips, 250 / 150 / 100 um tapers, 4.4 x 4.2 um SiON overlay, 300 nm TFLN, 4.7 um BOX

showcase.criterion: foundry platform edge coupler with measured loss ( typical)
showcase.rationale: STMicroelectronics PIC100G SiN inverted-taper edge coupler, below 0.7 dB TE / 0.6 dB TM (taper + transition, GC-based test structures); BOX above 5 um; tip and taper length not reported

showcase.criterion: foundry PDK edge coupler with measured loss ( typical)
showcase.rationale: CUMEC 130 nm Si/SiN PDK SiN inverse taper, 1.6 dB per coupler (TE, 7.5 um MFD fiber); 300 nm SiN, 1 um to 350 nm taper; taper length not reported

showcase.criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm
showcase.rationale: 3.5 dB per coupler (printed -3.5 dB peak fiber-to-waveguide efficiency; -5 dB before a 170 nm SiN backside AR coating), through-substrate (downward) 1D GC measured from the chip backside; period 490 nm, fill factor 0.5, 70 nm etch, 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX, 2 um oxide to a Ti/Al top reflector (reflector and thinned substrate not drawn); imec 200 mm Si photonics pilot line; first SOI hero for the template

showcase.criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm
showcase.rationale: 5 dB per GC at 532 nm with period 288 nm, fill 0.6, 100 nm etch, -10 deg fiber angle, 200 nm TFLN, 2 um BOX; second platform (lnoi_rib)

showcase.criterion: foundry platform 1D GC with measured per-coupler IL ( typical); SOI
showcase.rationale: Samsung Foundry 300 mm SiPh platform GC, 1.9 dB per coupler, 27 nm 1-dB BW; stack 305 nm Si / 2 um BOX; period and etch depths not reported

showcase.criterion: foundry platform 1D GC with measured per-coupler IL ( typical); SiN
showcase.rationale: Samsung Foundry SiN GC on the same platform, 2.1 dB, 57 nm 1-dB BW; 400 nm SiN; second platform for the template

showcase.criterion: highest measured responsivity x 3-dB bandwidth among waveguide Ge PDs with a drawable top view (absorber length and width)
showcase.rationale: best device 1.19 A/W at 102.1 GHz (-2 V, paper FoM 121.5 GHz A/W); wafer mean 1.16 A/W / 101 GHz over 24 dies; Ge 600 nm x 40 um, 220 nm SOI, 3 um BOX; Ge thickness not reported (cross-section schematic for Ge); 200 mm line of the authors (fab org not named)

showcase.criterion: highest measured responsivity x 3-dB bandwidth among waveguide Ge PDs with a drawable top view (absorber length and width)
showcase.rationale: 1.01 A/W (1310 nm) and 110 GHz (-3 V); the only candidate with all required top and cross-section dimensions (Ge 550 nm x 30 um x ~300 nm on 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX); 300 mm SOI platform, fab org not stated

showcase.criterion: foundry (imec 300 mm platform) waveguide Ge PD with measured performance and a drawable top view
showcase.rationale: imec 300 mm SiPh: 0.93 A/W mean over 7 dies at 1310 nm, >110 GHz at -0.5 V, Cj 3.1 fF; Ge 300 nm x 10 um, 220 nm SOI, 2 um BOX; Ge recess depth not reported

showcase.criterion: foundry (CEA-Leti 200 mm platform) waveguide Ge PD with measured performance and a drawable top view
showcase.rationale: CEA-Leti 200 mm platform, butt-coupled lateral Si/Ge/Si PIN: >0.8 A/W at -1 V (1310 nm); intrinsic Ge 1 um x 15 um, 300 nm Si waveguide level, 0.8 um BOX; Ge thickness and bandwidth not reported. All drawable ge_pd candidates are SOI, so a second platform is not available

showcase.criterion: lowest measured p_pi_mw among thermo-optic phase shifters with a stated heater length (to-scale top view)
showcase.rationale: 0.095 mW per pi at 1550 nm (sinusoidal fit of MZI transmission vs heater power, Table 2); device 5, underetched: 10 um wide heater of length 290 um over 9 dissimilar Si passes (widths 400-650 nm, gap 0.5 um), 220 nm SOI, substrate removed under a 12 um suspended bridge; IME 248 nm lithography. MZI-level switch, one arm folded under the heater

showcase.criterion: lowest measured p_pi_mw among thermo-optic phase shifters with a stated heater length (to-scale top view)
showcase.rationale: 0.63-0.67 mW per pi at 445 nm (MZI outputs 1 and 2, first half-period, Table III; text 0.65 mW); TiN heater 983.8 um long and 10 um wide over 7 folded SiN passes (550-650 nm, 6.9 mm under the heater) on a suspended SiO2 bridge with Si undercut; AMF 200 mm visible platform; SiN about 130 nm and heater-waveguide separation about 1.86 um from XTEM of a second wafer (nominal 150 nm); second platform (sin)

showcase.criterion: median measured p_pi_mw of the phase_shifter.thermo_optic subtype (47 components with a measured P_pi)
showcase.rationale: 15.5 mW per pi (O-band, 25 C, Table 2) is the median (24th of 47) of the measured P_pi values, and a foundry device: STMicroelectronics PIC100G, TiN heater between metal 1 and metal 2, 300 nm SOI with a reconstructed BOX above 5 um; heated waveguide type and all heater dimensions not reported, so the drawing is schematic

showcase.criterion: foundry (Luxtelligence dedicated run) thermo-optic phase shifter with measured performance
showcase.rationale: Luxtelligence-fabricated TFLN: 68.4 mW at 594 nm, 78.1 mW at 640 nm; 0.75 mm TO section (heater length not reported), 325 nm wide 150 nm strip, 4.7 um BOX, 1.6 um SiO2; 900 nm Au four-pass meander heater beside the arm, 250 nm above the LN top (Fig. 1(d)), lateral spacing not stated

showcase.criterion: lowest measured excess_loss_db per_component among MMIs reporting body width and length
showcase.rationale: 0.06 dB excess loss per 1x2 MMI at 1550 nm (TE) from the slope of a linear fit over a cascaded MMI tree; multimode body 3.6 x 11.5 um, access tapers 0.5 to 1.2 um; 220 nm Si on 2 um BOX, 248 nm DUV in a 0.13 um CMOS line (fab not named). Replaces valdez2022 (0.2 dB, same platform). Next SOI MMI with both body dimensions: qiao2017 0.12 dB (SMIC, dimensions read from a figure). Splitter MMIs only; crossing.mmi ranks by crossing_loss_db

showcase.criterion: lowest measured excess_loss_db per_component among MMIs reporting body width and length
showcase.rationale: 0.8 dB standalone 2x2 MMI, 4.8 x 31.4 um body, 1.2 to 2.15 um access tapers over 15 um, full TFLN rib stack; second platform (lnoi_rib); tie with li2022b (0.8 dB derived) broken by measured basis and geometry completeness

showcase.criterion: foundry MMI with measured excess loss closest to the median of measured / derived per-MMI excess loss (0.2 dB, n = 23 splitter.mmi components), reporting body width and length
showcase.rationale: A*STAR IME CMOS-compatible process: 2x2 MMI of a 16 x 16 EO switch, body 5 x 29.5 um, about 0.22 dB per MMI at 1560 nm from the linear fit of a cascaded test structure (average about 0.4 dB over 60 nm); 220 nm Si rib, 60 nm slab. Replaces kieninger2020 (IME, 0.27 dB, MMI dimensions not reported)

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW MMI with measured excess loss and both body dimensions, second platform
showcase.rationale: Applied Nanotools SiN MPW process: 1x2 MMI, body 3.9 x 10 um; excess loss 1.22 +/- 0.16 dB and imbalance 0.04 +/- 0.40 dB across the C-band against a straight SiN reference waveguide (single device, no cascade). Only non-SOI foundry MMI with both body dimensions and a measured excess loss

showcase.criterion: highest measured output_power_mw among ridge_laser-template components with a reported cavity length
showcase.rationale: >450 mW CW at 25 C (chip, 0-1000 mA), 1.8 mm cavity (Furukawa); ridge / mesa width and layer stack not reported, so the cross-section is schematic. The same 1.8 mm design in W3E.1 reports output_power_dbm only (+26 dBm), not converted

showcase.criterion: highest measured output_power_mw among ridge_laser-template components with a reported cavity length
showcase.rationale: >200 mW at 25 C (integrating sphere, L-I up to 1 A, Fig. 2(a)); InGaAsP/InP DFB, 1.75 mm cavity, HR back / AR front facets, dual-channel shallow ridge; ridge width and layer stack not reported, so the cross-section is schematic; fab org not stated; platform inp (W1B.3 material not stated)

showcase.criterion: median measured output_power_mw of the laser.dfb subtype (7 components with a measured value)
showcase.rationale: 40 mW at 150 mA, 600 um single-section DFB, the laser.dfb median (4th of 7); ties with the two-section laser of the same paper (40 mW, 2 x 300 um), broken by geometry (one total cavity length); material, ridge width and reference plane not stated

showcase.criterion: highest measured q_intrinsic among ring_bus components with a reported radius (to-scale top view)
showcase.rationale: Q_i 566 M at 1064 nm (weak coupling), > 100 M from 458 to 1550 nm; radius 750 um (1.5 mm diameter), 10 um core; ge_silica. Coupled with a U-shaped fiber taper (no bus waveguide); width only as the 3-30 um design range; reflowed, nearly circular cross-section

showcase.criterion: highest measured q_intrinsic among ring_bus components with a reported radius (to-scale top view)
showcase.rationale: Q_i 145 M (loaded Q 65 M, 30 dB extinction) at 780 nm, TM mode, from an unbalanced-MZI-calibrated resonance scan; radius 5.84 mm as printed for the two resonators of the 0.36 dB/m loss fit; Si3N4 core 40 nm x 4 um on 15 um lower SiO2, 6 um upper SiO2; bus-waveguide coupled; fabrication credited to Honeywell (acknowledgement). Second platform (sin). Gap and bus width not reported (drawn schematically). Replaces M1D.4 (sin, Q_i over 30 M). Higher measured Q_i among ring_bus components is ge_silica only (Th1D.6, Th1D.7, chen2026a)

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW ring or MRR filter with measured performance, ranked by completeness of template geometry
showcase.rationale: HyperLight wafer-scale x-cut TFLN process (248 nm DUV, 4-inch NanoLN wafer): ring radius 80 um, 2.0 um wide, 400 nm etch in 600 nm LN (200 nm slab), 4.7 um thermal SiO2, 800 nm PECVD SiO2; measured Q_i 1.8 M (0.21 dB/cm) for the lowest-loss ring near the wafer centre, identical linewidths for red and blue scans. 7 template dimensions; gap and bus not reported. LN platform; reports the template primary metric

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW ring or MRR filter with measured performance, ranked by completeness of template geometry
showcase.rationale: imec iSiPP200 SiN 2-bus MRR: radius 75 um, ring and bus width 840 nm, gap 700 nm, 400 nm core; measured FSR 314 GHz and 18.7 dB extinction; no Q reported

showcase.criterion: lowest measured transition_loss_db among transitions reporting a taper or coupler length and both layer thicknesses
showcase.rationale: 0.06 dB per coupler (as low as), 35 um taper, Si 450 to 160 nm under SiN 350 nm to 1 um, 220 nm Si / 300 nm SiN, ~180 nm gap, 3 um BOX (CUMEC PDK layers)

showcase.criterion: lowest measured transition_loss_db among transitions reporting a taper or coupler length and both layer thicknesses
showcase.rationale: 0.185 dB per coupling (TE, linear fit over cascades of 16-40 couplers against straight references) for an asymmetric vertical coupler from a 50 nm to a 150 nm Si3N4 layer, 100 um tapers; tri-layer Si3N4 / SiO2 platform (150 / 50 / 150 nm); inter-layer gap and tip widths of the measured device not stated; second platform (sin)

showcase.criterion: foundry platform Si-SiN transition with measured loss ( typical)

Conversion gain (converted output / signal input) stored as power_conversion_efficiency_pct (dB -> %, derived) until a conversion-gain parameter exists. Conversion NF not entered (no frequency_converter NF parameter): Tx about 6 dB over 1624.23-1675.99 nm, Rx about 5 dB, beyond-U-band Tx 6-8 dB over 1675.99-1719.24 nm (p.2-3, Fig. 2-3). Two units, post-OPA (Tx) and pre-OPA (Rx), same configuration, Rx run at a higher SH-pump power: operating points in condition. Modules described as the authors' own development, all authors NTT, no fabrication statement: fab_org_ids empty. Gain flatness <= 3 dB within the conversion bands (p.2) has no parameter. Input total-power tolerance ~16 dBm (1 dB SNR penalty with ~4 dB gain reduction, Fig. 4, sentence cites [26]) is not a saturation-power definition: not entered. X / Y path-length difference <= 0.5 mm (p.2) is an assembly setting.

N-stage planar (Spanke-Benes) architecture folded into a single row of pre-positioned active islands, hence extra bends and crossings; two connections inadvertently exchanged, 20 valid paths remain (p.2). Uncoated cleaved facets, all I/O on one facet, chip on an AlN carrier (p.3). Electrode faults: d shorted to the substrate, b and c shorted by imperfect gold lift-off (p.4). Not entered: Table III passive losses (20.8-43.4 dB; budgets computed from the Table II test-structure values and Table I component counts, footnote 1; the inputs are on their own rows); OSNR 23.0 dB/0.06 nm worst (I1->O2) to 39.5 dB/0.06 nm best (I3->O1), > 37 dB/0.06 nm on five paths (p.5); power penalties 0.6 / 1.2 dB for 2 / 4 stages at 160 Gb/s (p.6), 0.8 dB static and 2.0-2.2 dB dynamic on a 10 Gb/s tributary (p.6); energy about 1.6 pJ/bit (estimate, p.8): no registry parameters. Laser oscillation between the facets at 122 mA (electrode i) and 95 mA (g or h) on the low-loss paths (p.5). Sec. V measurements at a fixed 22 C. The authors' earlier 160 Gb/s conference report (ref. [28]) is not cited for any value here. Cross-rows: SOA gate cmp_lit_alboresmejia2010_soa_gate_1mm, MMIs, mode transformer, waveguides, facet coupling.

components.label: Air-bridge Si 2-D PhC heterostructure nanocavity, a1 410 nm, 220 nm slab, Q 1.11e7
components.core_material: Si 220 nm (boron doped, 10 ohm cm)
components.notes: Triangular lattice, hole radius 110 nm (Fig. 1(a), p.5; no parameter for the hole radius), 17 missing holes, x lattice constant increased by 3 nm twice from the center outward every two periods, selected holes shifted 0.001 a1 and 0.002 a1; excitation waveguide 10 % wider than the cavity, six rows away; PC area 300 x 15 um with nine cavities at 20 um period (p.3-4). One design measured as eight cavities (#2 could not be measured; p.8 Table 2). Qexp = omega tau from photon-lifetime decay, so it is a total Q including the excitation-waveguide load: q_loaded. Treatment cycles: dry oxidation (OX) and dilute HF (DHF), p.5. Not in the registry (report): modal volume 1.4 cubic resonant wavelengths in the material (p.3); photon lifetime 9.2 ns (p.6, p.8); loss split 1/Qdes, 1/Qscat, 1/Qabs about 20 %, 35 %, 45 %, Avg(1/Qabs) about 5.8e-8, sigma_hole about 0.25 nm (p.9). Text and Table 1 differ slightly for cavity #6: 6.3 vs 6.2 million after fabrication, 1565.30 vs 1565.33 nm after DHF #1 (p.5 vs p.7). Wafer: SOI by Soitec (Smart Cut; supplier only, p.4). Fab empty: passive fabrication sentence, no org named (authors at Kyoto University and Osaka Prefecture University).

components.notes: Fab: K.J.M. (Columbia, Dept. of Electrical Engineering) fabricated the devices (p.8 Author contributions); 'We fabricate the devices' (p.9 Methods). Work performed in part at the Cornell NanoScale Facility (p.8 Acknowledgements). Process (p.9): 100 mm Si wafer, 4 um wet thermal oxide, 690 nm LPCVD SiN in two steps with a high-temperature anneal between, oxide hard mask, EBL, plasma dry etch, 3 h Ar anneal, high-temperature SiO2 cladding, Pt microheaters by lift-off, deep Si etch for the edge couplers. Same physical device as cmp_lit_beals2026_spiral_16ghz. Pumped by an amplified fixed-frequency external laser near 1560 nm (Fig. 1(d), Fig. 3(b); setup, not a row). Not entered (no registry parameter): minimum pump power to reach the soliton regime 232 mW with the active-kick technique vs 627 mW with heater kick (p.5 Fig. 3(a)); stabilized soliton existence time up to 4.2 days vs about 50 ms / 2.3 ms with heater kick (p.4-5); breathing frequency about 350 MHz (p.5-6); soliton numbers up to about 50 (p.5); automated generation 50 of 50 attempts (p.4, Fig. 3(f)).

Launched pump printed as 17.34 mW (p.3) and 17.31 mW (p.6 Table 1, p.7). Fluorescence lifetime ~2.3 ms is material data: not entered.

components.core_material: Seven CBE layers on a (100) Zn-doped p+ InP substrate: 0.25 um Be-doped p-InP buffer, Sn-doped n-InP multiplication typically 0.6-0.7 um, three ~70 nm InGaAsP transition layers (Eg 1.13 / 0.95 / 0.80 eV), unintentionally doped n-InGaAs absorber 1.8-2.8 um, n+ InP cap; electroplated Au-In-Zn / Au-Sn contacts; Br-methanol mesa etch; illumination through a window in the p contact and the substrate; low-capacitance pill package
components.notes: Fab org_bell_labs, borderline: all four authors at AT&T Bell Laboratories (p.1 footnote; printed name maps to org_bell_labs as merged hayashi1970 / kogelnik1971 rows); first-person processing 'by thinning the substrate to less than 25 um and depositing an AR coating ..., we have obtained' (p.3) and thanks to a named person 'for assistance with device fabrication' (p.5; borderline); growth by the authors' own CBE system (p.1, design cited to ref. [16]). No facility. One row for the APDs of Figs. 3 and 5: the paper does not tie them to one absorber thickness (it says only that the highest frequency response comes with ~2 um absorbers, p.3); the 3 um AR-coated Fig. 4 device is cmp_lit_campbell1988_sagm_apd_3um_ar. Dark current and breakdown of the Fig. 3 device are figure reads (audit): breakdown about 64 V where the dashed dark-current curve turns vertical, and about 34 nA at about 57 V reverse (about 90 % of that breakdown). components.label: SiN-to-Si vertical evanescent coupler with Si inverse taper (feeds the Si PIN PD), 850 nm
components.core_material: SiN 220 nm x 600 nm waveguide over a Si 220 nm (SOI) inverse taper; 50 nm SiO2 liner below the SiN
components.notes: Fab: p.2 passive ('The optimized devices were fabricated'); all authors at the Indian Institute of Science (Centre for Nano Science and Engineering, Molecular Biophysics Unit); no fabrication statement naming an org -> fab_org_ids empty; acknowledgment lists funding only (no facility). Process (p.2-3, Fig. 4): SOI 220 nm Si on 2 um BOX; Si patterned by optical lithography + dry etch, SiO2 + CMP, p+ / n+ by diffusion doping (windows 4 um apart), 50 nm SiO2 liner, LPCVD SiN 220 nm patterned by EBL + dry etch, Cr/Au contacts. arXiv text (v1, compiled 2019-01-07); figure fonts in the render are garbled (Figs. 3, 6, 7, 9-12 axis labels unreadable), so no values read from those panels. The taper is fabricated as the input of PD devices D1-D3 (Fig. 5 table: D1 Ws 180 nm / We 300 nm, D2 180 / 450 nm, D3 300 / 450 nm, each with LT = 5 / 10 / 15 um); only the simulated coupling of the optimized 15 um taper is stated (Fig. 3(b), whose Ws legend is unreadable in the render), so one row with the D1-D3 variants here (fabricated). The vertical SiN-Si spacing after CMP is not stated (gap not entered).

components.label: TM linearly chirped spiral Bragg grating, W_corr 60 nm, 4 mm, -6 nm/cm chirp, 220 nm SOI
components.core_material: Si 220 nm strip (single full etch, EBL) on 3 um BOX, rectangular corrugations on both sidewalls, grating wrapped into two interleaved Archimedean spirals joined by an S-bend
components.notes: Linear chirp dLambda/dL = -6 nm/cm from 444 nm (p.8; no chirp-rate parameter). Measured average group-delay slope -11 ps/nm over the passband (Luna OVA, p.13, Fig. 12), as designed (TMM, Fig. 4, with an assumed 2 dB/cm propagation loss): no group-delay / dispersion parameter (registry gap). Group-delay ripples attributed to the constant corrugation width. The 5 ps/nm TE chirped grating of ref. [56] is a cited value. Duty cycle printed only for the U-SBGWs (p.8): fill_factor not entered here. TM0 operation. Spiral design R0 = 15 um (S-bend semicircles) and 2 um spacing between the spirals (p.6-7): no reflector parameter for a bend radius or spiral gap (registry gap). Corrugation width W_corr = (Wmax - Wmin) / 2 (Fig. 2(c)) has no registry parameter; Wmax / Wmin not printed. Light coupled by three full-etch GCs on a 127 um pitch and a Y-junction to collect the reflection (p.9; both cited designs, refs. [52], [53], no values). Fab: the SBGWs were 'fabricated using electron beam (eBeam) lithography at the University of Washington' (p.9 Sec. 3.1): fab org_university_washington (simard2015 / eid2016 precedent). The acknowledgment (p.13) thanks a named staff member for fabrication at the Washington Nanofabrication Facility (WNF), which is not in the registry (facility role, report). CMC Microsystems is acknowledged for financial support only (not a fab org). Single full etch of a 220 nm SOI wafer on 3 um BOX, 2 um SiO2 cladding (p.9); EBL shot pitch 6 nm (p.10).

Measured via three structures (p.5, Fig. 2(b)): reference waveguide (L1), back-to-back TE10 mux-demux pair (L2), converter + TE10 demux (L3); L_conv = L3 - L1 - Lmux (Eq. 1), so the measured values are derived. components.core_material: GaAs substrate; bottom n-DBR 20 pairs AlAs / AlGaAs + 10 pairs Al0.9Ga0.1As / Al0.12Ga0.88As; 0.5-lambda active region with five In0.07Ga0.93As QWs and Al0.37Ga0.63As barriers; two pairs Al0.98Ga0.02As / Al0.12Ga0.88As oxidizable layers; top p-DBR 20 pairs Al0.9Ga0.1As / Al0.12Ga0.88As (graded interfaces, average p-doping about 1e18 cm-3); p+-GaAs cap; Ti/Pt/Au p-contact, dry-etched 15 um mesa, furnace oxidation, AuGe/Ni/Au n-contact, BCB passivation, Ti/Au GSG pads
components.notes: Values measured from 25 C to -50 C ambient (cryostat with temperature-controlled copper heat sink; temperature_k holds the converted ambient temperature). / Fig. 2(a), Fig. 5(a) and Fig. 6 are 'Adapted with permission' from the authors' own OECC 2020 paper (ref. [32], whose title prints 40.1 GHz at 223 K); their values are not entered: thresholds 0.6 / 0.62 / 0.7 / 1.05 mA at 25 / 0 / -25 / -50 C (Fig. 2(a) caption, p.4 text, Table 1 headers, Table 2 'This Work'), 4.4 mW peak at 12.7 mA (25 C) and 8.4 mW maximum with roll-off at 17.4 mA (-50 C) (p.4), maximum f3dB 30.8 / 35 / 40.1 GHz at 25 / -25 / -50 C (9.5 / 14.0 / 14.7 mA; Fig. 5(a), abstract, Table 2), the 40.1 GHz 14.7 mA trace again in Fig. 5(b) (same trace as Fig. 5(a)), junction temperatures 13 / 62 / 78 C at 10 / 14.7 / 16 mA (-50 C, from Fig. 6). Fig. 5(a) caption names 25, 0 and -50 C; legend and text name 25, -25 and -50 C. Not entered (no registry parameter): e-h recombination lifetime about 170 ps (25 C) to 113 ps (-50 C) and photon lifetime 5.5 to 4.1 ps (gamma vs fR^2 fit, Fig. 8, p.10); optical aperture about 4.8 um (Helmholtz estimate from mode spacing); 15 um mesa diameter; 8 nm gain-cavity detuning at 25 C (design); rms spectral width about 2 nm and transverse-mode split about 7 nm (p.5-6); Table 1 pad resistance Rp and junction resistance Rj. Fab empty: process steps in passive voice and 'We developed' (p.3); authors at National Taiwan University and UIUC. Facility pending org round: the acknowledgment thanks the Semiconductor Manufacturing Lab of the Consortia of Key Technologies and the Nano-Electro-Mechanical-System Research Center, National Taiwan University, for semiconductor device fabrication support (p.12); neither is in the registry. Staff thanks for FIB / SEM (NSTC, National Taiwan University) not entered.

components.label: InP monolithic hybrid mode-locked laser, 1 GHz, 41 mm linear cavity (150 um SA, 4 mm SOA, low-loss passive waveguide)
components.core_material: MOVPE InP wafer: 2 um Zn-doped p-InP upper cladding, six 9 nm InGaAs (Q1.55) QWs with 5 nm Q1.17 barriers, 0.5 um Si-doped InGaAsP (Q1.15) waveguiding layer, 1.5 um n-InP lower cladding; active-passive integration by QW wet etch; gain / SA waveguide 2.5 um x 0.5 um; SA 150 um, SOA 4000 um (Fig. 1(a)), 10 um gap (359 nm deep) between gain and SA; tapers 2.5 -> 5 um (170 um) and 5 -> 1.5 um (185 um) at the output; Fe-InP beside the waveguide core (Fig. 1(b) SEM); as-cleaved facets (about 30 % reflectivity) form the cavity
components.notes: Fab org_university_of_california_davis (borderline): the paper describes the integration process as 'our integration process' (p.2), the same method the group uses for AWGs, modulators and MZIs (refs. 3, 4); seven of eight authors at UC Davis, one at the Agilent Measurement Research Laboratory ( / caveat). No facility named. Laser soldered on an Al plate on a TEC; light from the right facet into a lensed fiber. Many SA lengths were fabricated on the chip; 150 um gave the best HML operation (p.2). Passive waveguides: cmp_lit_cheung2010_wg_w2p5, _wg_w5. Not entered (no registry parameter): RF carrier-to-noise ratio about 50 dB at 10 MHz RBW and RF-peak power 55 dB above the noise floor; RF peak width about 1 MHz at -20 dB; time-bandwidth products 5.1 (Fig. 4) and 3.6 (Fig. 5); overall cavity loss below 3 dB (p.2, roundtrip-loss parameter not in the registry); optical spectrum widths (Fig. 2(c) about 5 nm, Fig. 4(d) / 5(c) 100 GHz markers; level not stated).

'manufactured using MPW foundry service on an 8-inch SOI wafer by a CMOS-compatible process with ArF 193-nm deep ultraviolet lithography' (p.4) with 'chip fabrication support provided by Taiwan Semiconductor Research Institute (TSRI)' (p.5) -> fab org_taiwan_semiconductor_research_institute (MPW access provider named for chip fabrication support, / hung2020); the foundry itself is not named. Upper and lower silicon-oxide cladding (p.4); design stack 220 nm Si / 2 um BOX (p.3); strip vs rib not stated -> platform soi. Tunable laser 1270-1340 nm, 1 pm step (p.5). Mode-evolution region designed by multi-parameter adiabaticity engineering (MPAE). Design (p.3-p.4): W0 0.38 um, W1 0.4 um, W2 0.3 um, W3 0.35 um, W(z) 0 -> 0.05 um, g1 3 um, g2 0.15 um; regions I 5 um (tapers), II 20 um (S-bends), III L = 27 um, IV 10 um (S-bends), V 5 um (tapers). A linear-taper reference design needs L = 63 um (simulated, p.4; no performance value, no row). Measured bar / cross spectra normalized per the procedure of ref. 25 and fitted with high-order polynomials (p.5, Fig. 6). The printed '3 +/- 0.5 dB' window is used only as the bandwidth criterion (not an imbalance). Insertion / excess loss not reported (normalized spectra). TE and TM grating couplers have their own rows.

components.notes: Each filter identical to the single-channel design except the period (250-265 nm, 1 nm steps, about 2.6 nm red shift per step); channels 1290-1330 nm; TiW heater above each filter (p.5-6). Through port degrades below about 1292 nm from the Bragg reflection of the long-wavelength channels (Fig. 4). Eye test on channel 9 at 10 Gb/s NRZ (system result). Apodized 4-port contra-directional Bragg add-drop filter: oval cladding perturbations (460 nm wide, 150 nm long, about 75 nm from the input waveguide) at period about 255 nm, N = 2500; bus 325 nm and drop 450 nm wide for a large FSR; Gaussian gap apodization G(z) with Gmin 0.65 um, H 2.5 um, a = 2.5 (p.2-3, Table 1, Fig. 1). Fab: 'fabricated at Applied Nanotools under multi-project-wafer (MPW) process' (p.4). Measured with an ASE source edge-coupled to the chip and an OSA; spectra normalized to the maximum of the through port (p.5).

components.label: Polarization-independent width-optimized MMI crossing (TE0 / TM0), 300 nm fully etched LNOI, 9 x 9 um
components.core_material: LiNbO3 300 nm (LNOI), fully etched (EBL + ICP); crystal cut not stated
components.notes: Fab: p.3 Sec. 3 passive ('The device is fabricated on the LNOI wafer'; EBL on negative resist, ICP full etch of the 300 nm LN layer, 1 um PECVD SiO2); authors at Henan Normal University, Southeast University and two Shanxi / Jincheng institutes, no org named for fabrication -> fab_org_ids empty. No facility named (acknowledgments list grants only). LN crystal cut not stated. Structure (p.2, Fig. 1, Table 1): four centrally symmetric width-optimized MMI arms, each digitized into 13 linear tapers with central widths W1-W13 = 1.50-1.93 um (Table 1 labels the row 'Length'), input waveguide 1.2 um, LMMI = 3 Lpi / 4 = 4.5 um; PSO + 3D-FDTD. Measurement (p.3-4): tunable laser 1480-1640 nm, polarization controller, power meter; spectra normalized to a straight single-mode LNOI strip waveguide on the same chip (Fig. 7). Fig. 5 shows a single crossing and a 10-crossing cascade; the paper does not say whether the printed IL comes from the single crossing or a cascade (no division shown). Measured IL is printed inconsistently: abstract / Sec. 1 '< -0.96 dB' for both polarizations, conclusion and Table 2 -0.80 (TE0) / -0.97 (TM0) dB, Sec. 3 best -0.50 / 0.65 dB; Fig. 7 traces read about -0.49 to -0.80 dB (TE) and about -0.64 to -0.96 dB (TM). Simulated tolerance (Fig. 4: dw +/-50 nm, dh +/-20 nm, sidewall +/-10 deg; performance 'competitive' over > 200 nm) not entered (no parameter).

Propagation loss printed as 'approximately 4 cm^-1' (p.5; method, structure and wavelength not stated) is not entered in dB/cm: the paper's own use of the loss coefficient is ambiguous. Supp. Eq. (1) (p.8) writes Q ~ pi N / (alpha lambda), the form that holds for a field (amplitude) coefficient, and the Supp. example (p.9) ties a 10 dB/cm loss to Q about 4000, which with N about 2.0 (Fig. 8) follows only when 10 dB/cm is inserted as alpha = 10 cm^-1. Readings of the printed value: 17.4 dB/cm (power coefficient), 34.7 dB/cm (field coefficient) or 4 dB/cm (the example's usage). Electrodes cover the whole device surface in this preliminary configuration (p.5). Tuning 0.14 GHz/V is about 50 % of the bulk EO activity per the authors (p.5-6); proposed improvements (> 1 GHz/V, Q 2e4, < 10 V) are projections, not entered. components.core_material: InP / InGaAsP (Q1.37) 350 nm lattice-matched core, 230 nm upper InP cladding, ridge etched 210 nm (single etch)
components.notes: Fab empty: p.6 Sec. 3 describes a single-etch process (EBL-patterned SiO2 hard mask, CH4/H2 ICP-RIE, time-controlled 210 nm etch) with passive verbs; the acknowledgment thanks three named people for support in device fabrication without an org (suzuki2014 precedent). Portions presented at ECOC 2021 (We4D.4, p.9): journal extension, values kept. Splits two orthogonal SOPs on the S2-S3 plane (+/-45 deg linear when theta = m pi) and outputs both as TE0 (p.2). Non-uniform adiabatic taper 2.0 -> 3.2 um over 700 um with f = 1/dn^2 (Eq. (1)); simulated TM0 -> TE1 conversion 95 % at L = 700 um vs > 2300 um for a linear taper (EME, Fig. 3(a)); simulated tolerance: width +/-200 nm and etch depth +/-40 nm leave the conversion almost unchanged (Fig. 4); not entered (no conversion-efficiency or taper-length parameter for polarization). PRS length 750 um = 700 um taper + 28 um MMI (cmp_lit_ito2022_mmi_1x2) + transition; about 1100 um with the S-shaped fan-outs (p.6). Measured at 1550 nm with a 2-nm ASE slice (incoherent) and with a tunable laser averaged over 1 nm (Fig. 6(b)); port power difference less than 0.8 dB and output TE purity more than 98 % for TE0 and TM0 input (p.7).

components.notes: Fab: the couplers and the alignment structures are printed in first-person two-photon steps (p.10 Sec. 2.2, p.15 Sec. 4); authors at Heidelberg University (two institutes) and University of Munster (one author at both), so the authors' org is not unambiguous: fab and facility empty (itoh2024 precedent). Interfaces a 16x1 GST photonic matrix (17 ports) with 16 TIR-coupled inputs via Y-combiners; 17.6 GBaud SLED eye after two couplers (p.12; system result, no row). Printed '-1 dB alignment tolerance of 4 um' (p.10) not entered: definition not stated and Fig. 4(d) reproduces it neither as a half-width (about 1.3-1.7 um) nor as a full width (about 2.6-3.4 um); see m7.

Grating row cmp_lit_kashyap1993_uv_bragg_gratings: the grating reflections read from the Port 3 dip (95.5 % before, 96.8 % after trimming) are on that row, the 13.5 dB rejection form here; the conclusion's '96% rejection within a band-stop of 1 nm' (p.3) is the same after-trimming measurement. The abstract text layer prints '135 dB' for the 1.35 dB loss (decimal point lost; body and Table I note print 1.35 dB). Corrugation profile 2A cos^e(pi z / a) + g with e = 6, g = 60.6 nm, A4 = 171.3 nm, a4 = 401.3 nm; taper cells [108.4, 247.2, 299.2, 326.7, 401.3] nm (p.2). SEM of the measured reflector: A4 = 164.5 nm, g = 63.5 nm (p.5); simulation with these values: 62 THz operating range, centre 6 THz lower and mean reflectance 19 % higher than measured. Simulated design bandgaps (TE-like 280.3-312.5 THz, complete 286.1-312.5 and 321.5-355.3 THz) not entered.

components.notes: Fab: 'We fabricate the devices' (p.5 Sec. 3), both authors at the University of Rochester; facility: acknowledgment places device fabrication at the Cornell NanoScale Facility and the Integrated Nanosystems Center at University of Rochester (p.10; the latter missing from the registry). Alignment: elastic averaging, rings on the PIC back (outer radius about 800 um, 10 um high, 100 um wide) on pillars of an SiO2-on-Si interposer (4 um high, radius about 600 um), 1000 x 1000 um2 cells (p.4, design). Measured placement: lateral misalignment 260 nm (+/-100 nm, optical microscopy) and height difference 238 nm mean, 66.1 nm std over 15 reassemblies (p.8): no assembly-accuracy parameter. Fig. 6 holds six ports per assembly; the sixth sits on the right plot border and also carries the right-axis misalignment reading. Audit read of the oxide ports (250 dpi, 420 px/dB): about -3.05 / -2.79 / -2.39 / -2.77 / -3.00 / -2.28 dB, i.e. best -2.28, mean -2.71, std 0.29-0.32 dB, matching the printed -2.3 / -2.7 / 0.3 dB (no conflict). Abstract / p.2 print -2.4 dB link loss between two PICs without naming the assembly or port (oxide port 3 reads about -2.39 dB). components.label: Hybrid Si / III-V three-level taper Type 1, Si 1.0 um at final taper, 24 um mesa, 1550 nm
components.core_material: SOI 700 nm Si, 400 nm deep trenches (rib), 1 um BOX, vertical outgassing channels; wafer-bonded AlGaInAs / InP III/V stack (8 x 7 nm AlGaInAs QWs, PL 1410 nm, 125 nm SCH layers, 1.5 um p-InP cladding, InGaAsP superlattice, 10 nm InP bonding layer; Table 1); no metallization
components.notes: Si-to-hybrid mode converter (rule 10: on-chip inter-material transition). three III/V taper levels start within 2.4 um of each other (Fig. 2 labels 1.2 um / 1.2 um); final III/V taper 80 um; Si tapered to 2 um for 100 um before the first III/V tip, then to 1.0 um at the start of the final level (p.3-4). Simulated QW confinement 15.6 % in the hybrid waveguide (p.4, Fig. 4; no parameter). Back reflection not entered: Table 4 (p.10) gives R_t -44.0 dB (one device, no error bar), an upper limit set by the setup noise floor (FT of HR-OSA transmission of polished devices, TE, Fig. 10); back_reflection_db is not allowed on waveguide_platform (registry gap). Loss values are per taper: p.6 calls the Fig. 5(b) result the taper (pair) loss, but the abstract, Sec. 3.3 and Sec. 5 state the Table 2 range 0.22-0.57 dB per taper, and a check of the Fig. 5(b) slopes (about 1.66 dB per section for Type 1 - 1.0 um minus 0.64 dB hybrid loss, about 0.64 dB per section for Type 2 - 1.5 um minus 0.2 dB; audit reading of the fitted lines on a 400 dpi render) gives twice the Table 2 values, so the table is per taper. Table 2 footnotes cite Fig. 6 for what is Fig. 5. Passive chip with blue-shifted QWs (PL 1410 nm) so the III/V is transparent at 1550 nm (p.2-3). Fab empty: 'A passive chip was fabricated' (passive voice, p.2); authors at UCSB (Kurczveil also HP Labs, Pintus also Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna). Measured with TE light at 1550 nm through 7 deg angled 2 um Si facets with lensed fibers, about 9.5 dB per facet (p.4-5).

components.core_material: SiN2 75 nm (upper, coupler layer) over SiN1 150 nm (routing), 100 nm nominal interlayer SiO2; n(SiN) about 1.82 at 488 nm; facet layer SiN2

Narrower tip for deep blue / violet wavelengths (Fig. 4(d)).

components.label: TiN micro-heater (omega-shaped wire) over a mid-IR 1D grating slow-light MZI arm, 3.9 um
components.core_material: Si device layer epitaxially thickened from 220 nm to 400 nm on 2 um BOX; 1D grating waveguide (lattice constant a = 1.03 um, thickness 0.4 um, 303 periods) with bilateral teeth Sx (width), Sy (length) around a central waveguide W; 6-period tapered-grating transitions; DUV lithography (248 nm), RIE; 120 nm TiN heater on the upper cladding
components.notes: Heater resistance and power not stated (only current); heater wires of 4-5 MZIs connected in series (p.4). Grating embedded in the signal arm of an unbalanced MZI with Y-junctions; inverse-taper butt coupling with ZrF4 fibers, tunable 3.64-4.12 um laser (p.2, p.4-5). Group index extracted from the MZI fringe spacing with a 2D-FEM-calculated reference-arm group index (Eq. 4), hence derived. Fabrication described in passive voice; authors at NUS and the University of Tokyo: no fab org.

Section lengths entered as length_um rows with the role in condition (guan2014 precedent). No facility statement; CMC Microsystems thanked for design / simulation software only (not fab).

Coupling efficiency defined as (P_inc - P_t - P_r) / P_inc from measured incident, transmitted and reflected powers, i.e. power guided along the grating (p.4 Eq. (3)); no taper or output path in this figure of merit. AR coating (150 nm SiN + 50 nm SiO2, PECVD) on the wafer back side (p.3). Same chip measured before (gc_full_etch_noclad) and after the top-cladding deposition (p.3-4). Duty ratio printed as groove width / period (p.5); 50 % needs no conversion. Simulated maximum about 60 % is for a 60 nm top cladding (q = 0 of Eq. (2b)); 530 nm (q = 1) is the fabricated periodic maximum (p.3). 3-dB angular tolerance about 4 deg (p.4) has no registry parameter. Fab empty: fabrication sentences are passive ('To fabricate the structures, a 3.26 um thick bottom cladding layer was thermally grown', p.3) and the authors sit at four unrelated orgs (IEF / Universite Paris-Sud, Multitel, Universidad Politecnica de Valencia NTC, KTH). components.core_material: InP photonic-crystal air-bridge membrane (about 250 nm) on semi-insulating InP, InAlAs sacrificial layer; line-defect waveguide with an embedded InGaAlAs MQW active region (3 QWs, 2.6 x 0.3 x 0.15 um, SEM); air holes 220 nm diameter; lateral p-i-n by Zn thermal diffusion (p) and Si ion implantation (n); offset output line-defect waveguide tapered to a 3 um wide waveguide
components.notes: Fab org_ntt: 'the device we fabricated' (p.2) with all authors at NTT Photonics Laboratories / NTT Basic Research Laboratories, NTT Corporation ( parent); staff thanked for fabricating the device (p.9, not a facility). PhC lattice constant has no registry parameter (in label). Design: cavity Q about 2.7e5 and mode volume about 0.15 um3 without output waveguide, about 3000 with it (FDTD, p.3; no laser Q parameter). Earlier devices with an InGaAs sacrificial layer (0.39 mA threshold, 180 fJ/b) are the authors' earlier work [19], [20] (not entered). Device with a = 430 nm stated for Fig. 5 (p.4-5); Figs. 6-7 attributed to it (same static section; the Fig. 6 threshold region around 8 uA matches the 7.8 uA kink; emission near 1567.8 nm, Fig. 6). Fig. 8 is not attributed: its device lases near 1558 nm (CW 40-200 uA; pulsed 1557.85 nm shifting to 1559.07 nm), about 10 nm from this device and about 31 nm from the a = 440 nm device (Fig. 9(b)), so the paper does not identify it; its pulsed wavelength and the 16.6 K active-region temperature rise at 300 uA (p.6-7, no parameter) are not entered. Fiber coupling: output collected into a single-mode fiber with a 10 dB coupling loss; waveguide power = detected + 10 dB (p.5). Not entered: Q 32,600 from the threshold linewidth (no laser Q parameter), rate-equation fits beta 0.4 / 0.1 and eta_i 0.09 / 0.14 (p.6).

No facility named (acknowledgments list grants only). Structure (p.2-6, Fig. 1): four 800 nm input / output strips, SHM tapers (outer width w -> wM over LT = 2.4 um; hole width w1 = 60 nm -> w2 = 90 nm over Ls = 0.8 um, n1 = 4 periods, 10 nm steps) into two orthogonal 2 um wide SHMWs (MMI with a central 1-D hole array) of length LM = 22.6 um; hole period 200 nm, duty cycle a / period 0.4 (no registry parameter for hole width / hole duty cycle). Designed by Rytov estimate then 3D-FDTD (Lumerical, 40 nm grid), FOM 0.839 at 1550 nm (p.6). Measured as ten cascaded crossings: TM0 / TM1 through a counter-tapered DC mode MUX and two DEMUXs with TM-type GCs, TE0 with TE-type GCs, normalized to reference waveguides on the same chip (p.8-9, Fig. 7); SuperK EVO source + AQ6375B OSA. Simulated reflection (-13.1 / -35.4 / -31.2 dB at 1550 nm; < -11.9 / -30.2 / -31.2 dB over 1500-1600 nm, TE0 / TM0 / TM1, p.6) not entered: no reflection parameter for crossings. Table 1 (p.11) lists this work as IL < 0.9 dB, CT < -29 dB at 1.55 um and about 80 nm bandwidth (CT < -20 dB); the text gives cross-port CT < -38 dB (p.10). Simulated tolerance to outline / hole width errors (Fig. 5) not entered. Smallest holes partly unresolved in SEM (p.10).

components.notes: Optimized device of the paper (p.5 Sec. V-C): input aperture = 42 um long, 4 um wide shallow taper plus 5 um wide, 15 um long MMI; array waveguides tapered to 2 um at the star couplers with 0.2 um separation; output apertures 2 um, 25 um adiabatic taper to a 450 nm wire (p.2). Spectra de-embedded by subtracting the transmission of a reference waveguide with identical grating couplers (p.4 Sec. V). Grating couplers about 30 % efficient per ref. [15] (cited, not entered). Fab: 'The experimental AWG devices were fabricated through ePIXfab' (p.7 Acknowledgment): MPW access service named for fabrication (Contract v7); the foundry behind it is not named in the paper. All authors at Ghent University - IMEC (no first-person fabrication sentence). ePIXfab is not in the registry: fab empty until the org round (reported). Not entered: measured crosstalk 17.0 dB and simulated 19.5 dB (p.5-6): the value sentence carries the authors' own GFP 2011 paper [16] ('crosstalk of 17.0 dB [16]'), / pathak2012 precedent (the loss and non-uniformity in the same sentence carry no citation); aspect ratio (1-dB / 10-dB passband) 0.52 measured (p.7) and 0.49 simulated, 0.33 for a conventional AWG (p.5; no registry parameter); 1-dB / 3-dB / 10-dB bandwidth non-uniformity 0.23 / 0.17 / 0.15 nm (p.6-7; the ranges are in the bandwidth rows); channel spacing per channel pair about 360-419 GHz (Fig. 16). The Fig. 11 points of this 56-waveguide device (measured phase-error crosstalk about -16.8 dB read off the figure; neighbouring-channel crosstalk hidden in that floor, p.5) are the quantity the p.6 sentence attributes to [16]: not entered either (audit 2026-11-15).

Four-port push-pull MZI TE circulator: adiabatic 50/50 couplers, TE-TM polarization rotators at all ports, TM-NRPS Ce:YIG/Si arms driven by integrated electromagnets (push-pull currents). Two electromagnet layouts on identical passive MZIs: 3-loop coil (L1 1450 / L2 1520 um, single source) and 1-microstrip pair (L1 = L2 = 1020 um, Delta L0 70 um). Drive needed for the pi NRPS (5.35 nm shift): 50 mA with 1-microstrip on 8 um GGG, ~50% lower current and 1/4 power on 2 um GGG, 10 mA (~30 ohm, 3 mW) with the 3-loop coil (p.8, Fig. 11); no nonreciprocal drive-power parameter (gap). Loss breakdown (p.9): IL = 2 x 0.6 dB facets (cited [36]) + 2 x 2.0 dB rotators + 2 x 2.2 dB couplers + 6.4 dB arm, about 16 dB; 6.0 dB projected with a redesign (not entered). Isolation lower than the small-FSR device because of incomplete TE-TM conversion away from the rotator optimum (p.8).

Fab org_honeywell, borderline: the acknowledgment thanks Honeywell staff for mask design and sample fabrication, and the Honeywell first author conceived the design and fabrication process (p.10). arXiv text (page-1 title adds '3.4 Billion Absorption Limited Q'); same work as the source row by arXiv id; journal version not read. Non-reciprocity not entered: the frequency-shifted sideband for non-phase-matched (forward) probing is about 15 dB below the phase-matched (backward) sideband at the same detuning (p.10, mode pair 1; abstract: mode conversion asymmetry up to 15 dB); this is a conversion contrast, not a transmission isolation, so isolation_db does not apply (registry gap). components.label: Dual-sided coupled Fabry-Perot add-drop resonator (DC-FPR): pi-shifted multimode Bragg mode-conversion reflectors + asymmetric mode DCs, FSR-free, SOI
components.core_material: Si 220 nm SOI, 150 nm etch
components.process_name: EBL, ICP-RIE, Pt/Au heaters, XeF2 undercut
components.notes: Two Bragg mode-conversion reflectors (TE0_r <-> TE1) form the F-P cavity; asymmetric mode directional couplers phase-match TE0 bus to TE1. Heaters P1 (global, wavelength tuning) and P2 (local, intensity tuning). FSR-free single-peak bandwidth > 300 nm (simulated; measured devices show a single peak within the measurable range) entered as fsr_nm > 300 (m14, Table 1 FSR column). Separate devices for O, S and C bands (Fig. 2(e)-(g)). Undercut gives a nearly eightfold tuning-efficiency improvement and 12-inch MPW wafer-scale results (Supp. Notes 5-6, not cached; no numbers in the main text). Size 150 x 10 um from Table 1. Methods (p.16): 220 nm SOI, 100 kV EBL, ICP-RIE 150 nm etch, 800 nm PECVD SiO2, Pt/Au heaters, XeF2 undercut, wire bonding to a PCB. Author contributions (p.17): chip fabrication and packaging by authors at Westlake University and Zhejiang University -> fab org_westlake_university + org_zhejiang_university (two orgs); Crealights staff assisted with wafer-scale device fabrication (MPW, not a fab statement). components.notes: Fab: p.7 Sec. 5 states the structure was fabricated using the 300-mm-diameter SOI process of AIST (through-holes by ArF immersion lithography, gratings by KrF lithography). Design (p.3-4): 121 parameters optimized by CMA-ES with 3D FDTD; 17 grating rows; minimum hole / grating size 150 nm, spacing 100 nm, overlap 50 nm; W = 14.55 um, d = 96 nm, Ly = 4.76 um (fiber core position from grating start). Simulation fiber: SMF, 0.36 % index difference, 1/e2 MFD 9.7 um at 1550 nm, tip on the SiO2. Simulated power split at 1550 nm (Fig. 4(a)): upward 92.7 %, downward 6.3 %, reflection 0.8 %, pass-through 0.4 % (not entered; no parameter for directivity). Fabricated holes larger than design by 0-30 nm (10 nm average) longitudinally and 20-50 nm (30 nm average) laterally (SEM, p.7). Fabricated grating etch 97 nm (p.7) vs 96 nm design (p.4). Measured via an on-chip SSC and 2.1 mm Si waveguide (Fig. 8): fiber-to-fiber PMF-to-SMF minimum 4.0 dB at 1530.74 nm. Beam divergence 8.3 x 7.2 deg (FFP, 1540 nm, p.7): registry gap (beam_divergence_deg not allowed on fiber_chip_coupler). Spectrum oscillations: 0.14 nm / 1.0 dB fine and 1.8 nm / 0.6 dB coarse (p.8-9). Simulated tolerance: hole size within +/-10 nm and etch depth within +/-5 nm keep eta > 80 % (Fig. 6, p.6).

Fig. S2 (p.35) shows measured rings of 10 / 20 / 25 um radius. The paper attributes the S2 values (Q, FSR, FWHM, finesse, extinction) to the memresonator; entered as attributed. Extinction ratio printed as 27.55 with the definition Tmax / Tmin (p.32): entered as 14.4 dB (derived). Hewlett Packard Labs (all authors); no explicit fabrication statement (passive 'were fabricated', p.5), so fab_org_ids empty (contract v4). Measured device: microring with a 20 um diameter (Methods p.23); MRRs with radii 10-25 um were fabricated (p.5). Grating couplers ~6 dB each (row gc). Not an EO-atlas device (memory phase shifter; the cited 28 GHz bandwidth of similar III-V/Si MOS ring modulators is ref. [22, 26, 45, 46], not entered). Open licence (CC BY 4.0).

components.label: Four-channel optical-phased-array demultiplexer with fan-in / fan-out and adapter sections, 31 Al2O3 ridge waveguides on oxidized Si, 780 nm
components.core_material: RF-sputtered Al2O3 0.25 um (n 1.69) on thermally oxidized Si; ridge from a 40 nm atom-beam-milled step, 2 um wide (bimodal lateral guide, contrast 0.02)
components.notes: Fab empty: 'The experimental demultiplexer was fabricated' (passive, p.4) and the acknowledgment thanks J. W. M. van Uffelen and A. H. de Vreede 'for fabricating the devices' (p.6) without printing their affiliation (authors at Delft University of Technology;, cf. smit1988 where a first-person 'We realised' set Delft). Lithography: chromium mask from an optical pattern generator (ASET COMBO 250), 4x Canon reduction camera (FPA 141), image-reversal resist (p.4); no process name. Measurement: AlGaAs laser (775-785 nm, Peltier tuned) prism-coupled with a broad beam exciting input and reference channels together; cleaved end face imaged on a CCD; laser wavelength checked with a monochromator (+/-0.1 nm) (p.4-5). Polarization independence by choosing the focal length so the TE / TM dispersion angle equals the array-function period; aberration correction only for TE (p.3). Not entered: simulated IL below 2.5 dB and crosstalk -40 dB (Fig. 3, p.4); design channel isolation better than -45 dB (Table I); corrected focal length 193 um from gap filling over about 70 um (p.5).

components.notes: Fab: p.3 Sec. II 'Our devices are fabricated using the standard MPW flow of Advanced Micro Foundry (AMF)' -> org_amf; p.6 'fabricated in a commercial SOI photonics platform via an MPW run'. Separate absorption (lightly p-doped intrinsic region, 1e15 cm-3) and multiplication (n+, 3.5e18 cm-3) regions; p and n+ widths 1.15 / 1.05 / 0.95 um for W 1.1 / 1.3 / 1.5 um; p++ to n++ contact spacing 3.4 um (p.3). Table I values are at VB = 0.9 x Vbr (p.5); Vbr is defined at Idark = 10 uA (p.4) but not printed per device. Reverse bias stored negative (Table I prints positive VB). Responsivity uses P_in = 0.57 +/- 0.01 mW at the APD input, estimated from the lensed-fiber power minus the measured cutback facet loss (7.00 dB) and SiN propagation loss (p.4). Gain = photocurrent normalized to the photocurrent at the unity-gain voltage, taken as 4 V for all devices (measured range 2.4-4.4 V, p.8 App. D). Open eyes up to 40 Gbps for all variations (no parameter). Highest 3-dB bandwidth of the set (p.6) and highest Table I GBP 116.6 GHz (p.5).

components.core_material: Si 220 nm SOI; MZI arms 650 nm (wide) and 450 nm (narrow) strip sections, 450 nm common waveguides
components.process_name: CMOS-compatible process with 193-nm DUV lithography (8-inch multi-project wafer)
components.notes: Each MZI combines a wide (650 nm, L1 23.250 um) and a narrow (450 nm, L2 8.014 um) arm section so that dneff/dw cancels (Eq. (5)); identical tapers on both arms; S1 stages FSR 40 nm, S2 stages FSR 80 nm; multi-section MZIs with directional couplers of design cross coupling 0.5, 0.3, 0.23, 0.17, 0.05 (Fig. 5(b), p.6; 14 DCs and 10 MZIs per path, designed for 1550 nm). Channel grid 1510 / 1530 / 1550 / 1570 nm. Fabricated 'using a CMOS-compatible process with 193-nm deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography provided by a foundry' (p.5); foundry not named; mask replicated on an 8-inch multi-project wafer (p.6). Acknowledgment: 'chip fabrication support provided by OCP Asia, MOLEX' (p.8): MPW / fabrication-support org ( role) not in the registry, fab left empty and reported. TSMC appears only as a funding source (Joint Development Project, p.1), not as fab. Cladding of the fabricated chip not stated (the mode simulation assumes 2 um upper and lower oxide, p.2). Polarization not stated. I/O: a pair of broadband edge couplers with a single-mode lensed fiber (p.5; no coupler values). The paper extends the authors' preliminary conference report (ref. [25], p.2); values here are this paper's own. Channel numbering: Fig. 5(a) / Fig. 6 label 1550 nm as CH2, 1570 nm as CH3 and 1530 nm as CH4, and the Fig. 7(a)(b) panel titles (CH.1 / CH.4 / CH.2 / CH.3 over the 1510 / 1530 / 1550 / 1570 nm arrows) follow the same numbering, while the Fig. 7(c) legend maps CH2 / CH3 / CH4 to 1530 / 1550 / 1570 nm (each wavelength keeps its colour in every figure, so the legend renumbers in wavelength order). The p.6 observation (one die, Fig. 6) of lower crosstalk over 1550-1570 nm for both designs agrees with Table I under the Fig. 5(a) numbering (regular 21.4 / 20.9 dB at 1550 / 1570 nm vs 16.3 dB at 1530 nm) and not under the Fig. 7(c) legend (16.3 dB at 1570 nm). The paper does not state which numbering Table I uses, so Table I channels 2-4 are entered with the 1530-1570 nm span and the channel label, not one wavelength. Cross-note: cmp_lit_yen2020_regular_mzi_cwdm_demux (reference circuit on the same chips).

components.notes: Three-stage binary tree of 7 MZI filters (first filter 3 cascaded MZIs, second-stage filters 2, third-stage filters 1; 11 delay lines with TiN heaters, 5 directional-coupler designs kappa 0.5 / 0.29 / 0.2 / 0.08 / 0.04) (p.2-5, Table 1). Measured after manual thermal phase correction of all 11 heaters; spectra without correction are distorted (p.7). Spectra are 'normalized' (p.7): the normalization reference is not stated; grating couplers about 7 dB per facet (p.6). Measured channels shifted about 1.5 nm to shorter wavelengths than simulated (p.7). HSQ', overlay EBL in PMMA, Si / SiO2 dry etch, e-beam evaporated Au plugs with lift-off, 2 um PECVD SiO2; p.7-p.8) with all authors at UCSD -> fab org_university_of_california_san_diego (rule 12). TE-like excitation through a tapered PM fiber, output imaged through a polarizer (p.8). Earlier metallic-mirror resonator of the same group (ref. 22) not used. Standing-wave Fabry-Perot cavity (registry subtype photonic_crystal covers Fabry-Perot cavities). Design targets (p.7): Q0 2100, QC 300, FSR 21 nm, ER 20 dB at 1.55 um; mirror R 0.9, coupling coefficient 1400 cm^-1 at G = 240 nm. Fabricated device: mirror R about 0.8, coupling about 1200 cm^-1 'due to narrower waveguides' (fabricated width not printed), mirror tilt about 7 deg estimated from SEM, roughness of order 10 nm peak-to-peak (p.8). About 2 dB ripple from cleaved-facet reflections on the transmission spectrum (p.8). The abstract says the resonator 'exhibits an unloaded Q-factor of ~2100', which is the design value; Sec. 6 gives Q0 = 900 for the fabricated device.

Set B device (through port looped by a Y-junction mirror) used for the electrical results. Its Ge length is 16 um incl. 6 um of Ge tapers: p.5 names 'the 16 um long detector in device Set B', and the p.8 series-resistance estimate uses 16 um long slabs (m21). Set A transmission devices are 11 and 16 um long incl. 6 um of tapers (p.5). Not entered: 26 dB attenuation of the 16 um Ge strip at 1550 nm (Set A, Fig. 4; no registry parameter), 88 % simulated confinement, the 33.6 GHz transit-time and 36.8 GHz RC bandwidth estimates (model values), sensitivity gains vs the cited 0.75 A/W baseline, 40 Gb/s eyes. Fig. 4 legend colours of the 11 / 16 um traces cannot be tied to the curves. Responsivity rises above -5 V from avalanche gain (p.6); no gain value printed.

components.notes: Fab empty: p.12 Appendix says the chip was fabricated using the TriPleX Si3N4/SiO2 technology, proprietary to LioniX B.V. (p.5-6: a commercial TriPleX platform); p.13 Acknowledgments says the chip is provided by SATRAX B.V. and LioniX B.V. LioniX B.V. (2016 entity) is not in the registry and is not mapped to org_lionix_international (time-aware; a2011, bauters2013, mu2016 precedent; rejected LioniX BV only as an affiliation-only org); reported as a missing fab org. SATRAX B.V. is named only as chip provider (p.13) and as an author affiliation (p.1), with no fabrication statement: not a fab org. 2 x 2 asymmetric MZI with one ring on each arm; ring round trip twice the MZI arm difference (rings 1.4 cm, inter-arm delay 0.7 cm, p.12). 7 Cr heaters (Au leads) set the MZ couplers and phases; interleaver setting kappa_L = kappa_R = 0.5, kappa_1 = 0.87, kappa_2 = 0.32, phi_1 = phi_2 = pi, phi_D = 0 (Table 1, p.13); voltages computed with a custom simulation program. Each MZ coupler is 3450 um long (2100 um heater section + two 3-dB directional couplers of 675 um). -25 dB bandwidth 13.5 GHz (8 % roll-off; Fig. 1(d)) and 10-90 % resolution close to 0.5 GHz (p.6): no registry parameter (reported). FSR deviation about 0.02 % over 10 FSRs, passband centre deviation about 0.1 % of the FSR (p.7, p.12). Tuning speed of order milliseconds (p.12). Response measured with an EDFA ASE source and a high-resolution spectrometer; chip temperature-stabilized with a Peltier element (p.13). Propagation loss around 0.1 dB/cm is cited from refs. [24, 37] and not entered.
